protocol: Review-response runs (v1.8), fixed 2026-09-26 before any outcome of these runs. Descriptive; no gate.
Development bank unless stated; same controllers, charges, scheduler, and cost as v1.4-v1.7.
R4 (capacity-aware static split, no queue state). Static-prop: cloud share = cloud share of job capacity
under the calibration mean durations; requests ranked by the queue-free score difference J_c - J_e (mean RPC
time, mean fee, CARROT predicted shortfall), fixed random tie-break (seed 2026092602). Static-p: the same with
share p in {0.05, 0.10, ..., 0.90}; Static-best = the p with the lowest cost in hindsight for each reported
scope (baseline-favouring). Runs: four edge slots and one serial edge slot, all 12 conditions x 20 seeds; the
primary condition at loads {0.35, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 0.9} for both slot settings. Fresh450 (exploratory, not a
confirmatory hypothesis): the same Static-prop/Static-p runs on the 12 conditions for both slot settings and at
loads 0.35 and 0.9 (primary), using the frozen fresh bank.
R2 (predictor accuracy). Noisy oracle: realized qualities plus fixed per-task Gaussian error with standard
deviation sigma in {0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5}, clipped to [0, 1], used in CARROT-Queue (kappa 0.5), 12
conditions x 20 seeds, four edge slots. sigma = 0 must reproduce Oracle-Queue. Report cost against the
predictor's quality mean squared error, together with the CARROT, Mean, and RouteLLM-score predictors.
R1 (serial edge as the measured-hardware setting). One serial edge slot: the quality-weight sweep beta in
{4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 36} for CARROT-Queue, FPI, Shortfall, Utility (12 x 20), the payload sweep {1, 2, 4, 8, 12}
for CARROT-Queue/Radio, Mean-Queue/Radio, Intrinsic, and loads 0.35 and 0.9 for Intrinsic, Shortfall, Utility,
CARROT-Queue, FPI (the other loads exist). Report whether each four-slot conclusion holds with one slot.
